# Chess openings

Learn a few openings well instead of many badly.

## Italian Game

After 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4, White aims the bishop at f7, the weakest square in Black's camp, and castles early.

## Sicilian Defence

Black answers 1. e4 with c5, fighting for d4 from the side. The positions are sharp and lopsided, which suits players who want winning chances with the dark pieces.
